desc: The Vapor Lightweight Scope Level represents an affordable, American-made quality accessory for your rifle. It's designed to attach directly onto your scope tube, ensuring the reticle remains consistently level—a critical factor as target distances increase. This scope level is specifically crafted to allow shooters to maintain reticle alignment without adjusting their stance or the rifle's position, providing ambidextrous configurations suitable for right or left-hand use. Installation is recommended in front of the turret assembly on the weak-eye side, creating an illusion of the bubble floating near your reticle when viewing with both eyes open.
